exact: actin filament bundle convergence involved in cytokinetic actomyosin contractile ring assembly
related: actin filament bundle convergence involved in actomyosin contractile ring formation

definition: A process of actin filament bundle distribution that occurs in the context of assembling an actomyosin contractile ring during cytokinesis, and that results in the compaction of actin filaments into a tight ring.
